content: Benadryl is a brand name used by Johnson & Johnson (acquired in the fall of 2006) and Pfizer for various allergy medications. The primary active ingredient in the original Benadryl formulation is diphenhydramine, which is classified as a first-generation antihistamine. This medication is also available in formulations that combine diphenhydramine with other active ingredients, marketed under different variations of the Benadryl name. Benadryl Allergy Relief contains acrivastine, which is a second-generation antihistamine. Additionally, Benadryl Once a Day contains cetirizine, another second-generation antihistamine.
